name: How do I know if my whole-house remodel is luxury or mid-range?

mainEntity.name: What separates a mid-range whole-house remodel from a luxury remodel in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What separates a mid-range whole-house remodel from a luxury remodel in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The difference between a mid-range and luxury whole-house remodel is not just the price. Mid-range projects usually focus on quality improvements with standard layouts, practical material selections, and fewer structural changes. Luxury remodels typically involve custom design, premium finishes, more detailed millwork, high-end appliances, sophisticated lighting, and stronger architectural integration. Luxury projects also tend to require more design time, more coordination among trades, and greater attention to details like alignment, sightlines, and finish consistency. In Los Angeles, the neighborhood and the home’s existing value also affect what feels appropriate. Homeowners should decide early whether the goal is broad market appeal or a highly tailored custom home. That decision influences the level of finish, the engineering involved, and the final budget. A contractor can help classify the project correctly so expectations match the scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mid-range remodels usually use standard layouts, quality but common finishes, and limited structural changes. Luxury remodels often include custom cabinetry, premium stone, designer fixtures, major layout changes, and higher design and engineering complexity.
